heading: Designed North Star ideal solution and then derived feasible plan after discussion with the engineer team.

blocks.html: After developing my initial solution, I invited the PM and engineers to discuss the feasibility of the strategy for handling cross-month undelivered packages. During the workshop, we collaboratively discussed and co-created a feasible solution.
Seamlessly merge undelivered package data from the previous month into the current day's task list.
Achieve an integrated view for easier task management.
Eliminate the need for drivers to separately manage undelivered packages.

blocks.alt: Espoirer — Designed North Star ideal solution and then derived feasible plan after discussion with the engineer team.

blocks.html: The dimensions of the queries are separate, the backend system have to query two interfaces independently and then merge these two, which poses issues with backend data integration and modification.
Engineers want the current and previous months separate in the design to reduce backend operational complexity.
Implement a "Last Month" tag to keep data separate.
Display a task list for the previous month, including numbers of undelivered packages, in a distinct section.
